more_info.overview: This historical label names a sodium stearoyl fumarate preparation. Health Canada separately identifies sodium stearyl fumarate as the sodium salt of a monooctadecyl ester of fumaric acid. The similar names should not be treated as proof of identical identity without a preparation specification. The source identifies a natural-health-product ingredient, not a current direct food-additive application. Typical human-food uses under the supplied designation remain unconfirmed.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
